name: Matrix Canvas
description: Interactive Canvas 2D renderer for matrix tensors. It preserves the API Visualizer Load3D matrix language—rounded matrix bounds, quiet cell strokes, semantic row/column/written/padding/current states—adds gray-masked broadcast-result cells, and supports span-based aggregate cells for very large matrices.

visualContract: API Visualizer A2 logical matrix in pto_compute-graph-viewer/operator-planning/operator planning.html

useWhen: rendering a two-dimensional matrix tensor with row and column coordinates
showing current-row, current-column, written, padding, selected, or current-cell states
distinguishing source values from cells synthesized through matrix broadcasting
simplifying a very large matrix through an injected number of thumbnail cells with arbitrary source spans

extent.rows: positive integer count of source matrix rows
extent.columns: positive integer count of source matrix columns

cell.toneDefault: neutral when no interaction state or explicit semantic emphasis is supplied

aggregateSummary.rows: source rows represented by this cell
aggregateSummary.columns: source columns represented by this cell
aggregateSummary.intensity: optional normalized 0 to 1 strength for the centered thumbnail marker

requiredApis: window.PtoMatrixCanvas.render(canvas, scene, options) returning { update, resize, fit, setZoom, resetView, getViewState, destroy }
allowedOverrides: cell coordinates, spans, labels, values, tone, style, states, and aggregate summary
axis, grid, tooltip, and interaction visibility
zoom limits, wheel-scroll speed, and callbacks
forbiddenOverrides: copying or rewriting matrix geometry, rounded clipping, DPR setup, hit testing, wheel scrolling, zoom, label LOD, tooltip, or ResizeObserver logic in a consuming page
overriding the shared cell palette or replacing semantic PTO tokens with page-local UI colors
moving Load3D, Conv, tiling, playback, or tensor-format business rules into the Pattern
adding product-specific pane, card, toolbar, inspector, or playback chrome inside the renderer
embedding this Pattern through an iframe in consuming pages

typography.dataVizExceptionReason: Canvas labels are zoom-dependent data marks, but the renderer hides them before they would render below the shared 11px micro-label floor.
typography.dataVizFallback: Every visible cell has a readable DOM tooltip; aggregate cells expose source range, count, min, max, and mean.

textScaleContract: normal cell labels are hidden below 40 screen pixels on the shortest side; the current cell may label from 28 pixels
visible normal labels use the mono family and clamp between 11px and 14px
aggregate cells stay label-free at every zoom and use the tooltip for source span and statistics
labels never shrink below 11px; hover tooltip is the detail fallback at every zoom
broadcastContract: style broadcast means the cell value is synthesized through broadcasting rather than stored independently in the source tensor
broadcast cells retain the underlying semantic fill, add a neutral gray translucent mask, and keep the normal continuous grid boundary
source cells stay style value; for a [1,N] bias broadcast to [M,N], row 0 is value and rows 1 through M-1 are broadcast
broadcast may be combined with tone and interaction states such as current, selected, or muted
tooltip and live status expose style broadcast as a non-visual fallback
aggregateContract: an aggregate cell remains positioned in source coordinates and uses rowSpan and columnSpan to cover its represented source region
aggregate cells stay inside the same continuous square grid as detail cells and add one centered rounded marker; selected aggregate cells use the full primary fill
the business may inject any rowSpan and columnSpan per cell, or request a target thumbnailRows and thumbnailColumns count
marker intensity may be injected through summary.intensity; createAggregatedCells derives it from aggregate means
createAggregatedCells generates arbitrary thumbnail-grid counts without changing the source matrix extent
behavior: the matrix has an 8px-equivalent rounded outer clip and a quiet semantic-token outline
cells and generated aggregate cells default to neutral tone; semantic tones are opt-in and should represent an explicit interaction state or semantic emphasis
internal cells form one continuous square grid with straight separators; cells do not have individual gaps, rounded corners, or card-like outlines
broadcast cells add a neutral gray translucent mask while retaining the normal continuous grid boundary; source cells retain the normal fill
for a [1,N] to [M,N] broadcast, the source row uses style value and the generated rows use style broadcast
the current cell uses the warning fill and emphasized grid boundary without an inset outline
cell boundaries mirror the API Visualizer Load3D A2 matrix visual language
wheel scrolls vertically; horizontal trackpad gestures or Shift plus wheel scroll horizontally; both axes stop at the matrix bounds instead of behaving like an infinite canvas
when the matrix is smaller than the viewport it remains centered and wheel input is left available to the surrounding page
Control or Command plus wheel zooms at the pointer within the bounded scroll range; F or 0 fits; plus and minus adjust zoom
logical grid lines appear only when their screen spacing is useful; aggregate boundaries remain visible at overview scale
ResizeObserver refits until the user changes the view and preserves the user view afterwards
backing-store dimensions follow devicePixelRatio without changing CSS size
out-of-range cells are skipped with a development warning
the canvas tooltip and live status provide readable detail when labels are hidden
agentReuseRule: Load pattern.css and pattern.js, then call window.PtoMatrixCanvas.render with a canvas plus a business-neutral matrix scene. Mark source cells with style value and values synthesized by broadcasting with style broadcast; for [1,N] to [M,N], only the first row stays value. For very large data, keep scene.extent at the source shape and either pass arbitrary aggregate cells with rowSpan/columnSpan/summary.intensity, or call createAggregatedCells({ values, rows, columns }, { thumbnailRows, thumbnailColumns }). blockRows and blockColumns remain available when the business wants fixed source spans. Do not flatten the matrix extent to thumbnail-grid dimensions, copy wheel-scroll or zoom logic, or move product chrome and operator semantics into the Pattern.
